toolArgumentsForFutureRootApprovedGenera.prompt:
Create a brand-new TRUE RGBA transparent native sprite atlas for the CQC browser fighting game. Do not edit any existing generated atlas. The attached original game references guide silhouette and original palette, not invented fine detail.
Adult PREDATOR, the original 1990 MSX2 Metal Gear 2 human boss known under runtime alias JUNGLE EVIL. NOT the film alien. Match original PREDAT game capture and tiny sprite: compact green-uniform human with green covered head area and long dark conventional firearm. Retain the original green/dark palette and covered silhouette. No green ghillie invention or alien helmet. The exact gun model, firing technology, glove style and real face are unresolved. Use a restrained generic conventional long firearm outline that follows the visible source shape; do not add a branded rifle, flame nozzle, fuel backpack, grenade, laser, sci-fi plasma or magical invisibility. Yellow wheat/crops belong to original stage context, not to the actor atlas background. Pink mirror matte is not canon costume.
Produce sheet C_LEFT, exactly twelve COMPLETE separate full-body poses, ALL facing anatomically LEFT. Author this orientation independently, never mirror a previous atlas. Every toe, sole, hand and held weapon must remain within its own cell with ample empty transparent margin. Maintain identical character scale and costume across all 12 poses. Native landscape atlas with FOUR columns and THREE rows, read left to right then top to bottom. No text, cell borders, labels, grey matte, checkerboard image background, shadow floor, stage, watermark, detached effects, spare heads or extra mini bodies. Leave clear separation between all 12 connected actor silhouettes. Any held equipment must stay connected to the hands/body. Do not paint projectiles, explosions, flying stars, detached tripwires or muzzle flashes. Full opacity for actual cloth/body/gear; true alpha 0 outside actor. These are native source images and must never be cleaned, scaled or pixel-edited after generation.
Four triplets, numbered 0–11 in this exact order: 0,1,2=shoot: Conventional long firearm shouldering / visibly aimed first active barrel / re-settle, no muzzle flash or airborne bullet; 3,4,5=conceal: Low-profile terrain-hide preparation / crouched low body / rising recovery; body always visibly drawn, no wheat, no transparency trick; 6,7,8=cqcThrow: Adapted grapple preparation / unarmed hand throw follow-through with safely slung weapon / reset; no invented sling detail dominance; 9,10,11=recover: Conventional firearm reserve handling / unbranded reload-like action / shouldered-ready return, exact feed mechanics unspecified.
Render a crisp polished 2D sprite style grounded in the tiny original 1990 silhouette/palette. Do not claim invented anatomical detail, textures, balance actions or hardware is official 1:1. Aim for the nearest supported reconstruction, retain unknown details unobtrusively, and keep every complete pose suitable for independent native source cropping and foot-pivot measurement.
